summary: Added durable task leases, persisted dependency edges, bounded retry policy with exponential backoff and max attempts, checkpoints, cancellation/resume compatibility, idempotent queue actions, and a workspace-scoped queue view. Existing D1 installations receive additive migrations, Drizzle schema fields/indexes, strict migration error handling, SQLite-safe lease comparisons, and behavioral queue tests.

files.purpose: Validate claim, heartbeat, and release actions with worker and checkpoint fields
Persist leases, dependency edges, retry backoff/max attempts, checkpoints, queue ordering, and workspace/task-scoped transitions
Declare lease, dependency, and retry columns/indexes for Drizzle
Migrate existing tasks tables with lease/checkpoint fields and index
Migrate dependency edges and retry policy fields
Expose a bounded workspace-scoped queue view
Validate queue actions, dependencies, retry policy, lease fields, queue view and workspace isolation source contracts
Verify dependency blocking, retry backoff, lease recovery and idempotency
